"""CWE-22 safe: no confined-directory join of an untrusted segment.

Covers audited false-positive shapes: Path(__file__) repo root, open(whole
caller path), and CLI Path(argv[N]) as the intended root/target.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys


def _repo_root() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def load_template(path: str) -> str:
    path = Path(path)
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    out = Path(argv[0])
    stats_path = Path(argv[1])
    stats_path.write_text(str(out), encoding="utf-8")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
